notes: Cash basis county. Statement of Net Position p1 used for balance sheet (only cash, no liabilities). Top-level receipts from governmental funds statement p4 total column; Taxes 7,771,616 split into property and motor vehicle taxes 7,168,449 and inheritance 603,167 using the Statement of Activities (p2); the combined property/MV line cannot be separated further. Receipts 'Local' (and the Local detail lines) recorded as charges for services/fees: the Statement of Activities (p2) shows charges for services 1,357,677 of the 1,439,611 Local total. Disbursements: 'Debt service' not split into principal/interest. Detail: General Fund schedule (pp5-8) and the budget schedule for all other governmental funds (pp9-11) recorded; the nonmajor combining schedule (p12) duplicates the nonmajor lines in pp9-11 and is not recorded to avoid double counting. Object mapping: 'Personnel services' = salaries and wages; 'Operating expenses' (a catch-all object) = not itemized; 'Capital outlay' = equipment purchases; 'Equipment rental' = rent/leases. Printed lines showing '-' for actual are omitted (e.g., Bridge disbursements, Register of Deeds disbursements, Drug Law Enforcement, Opioid Recovery disbursements, Local Assist). General fund transfers out 4,730,000 are in the Miscellaneous department and are recorded as other financing; printed Total Cash Disbursements includes them. General fund transfers receipt budget 610,000 actual 0 omitted. Page 12 shows the PDF has 12 pages (printed page numbers differ). Read pages 1-12 of 12.
